name: dumbbell z press v. 2
description: An overhead press done seated on the floor with legs straight. The position removes leg drive and demands a strong core.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back tall.
Press both dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them to your shoulders under control.
Avoid leaning back during the press.
